name: Awin
description: Awin publisher APIs for programme discovery, product feeds, offers/vouchers, link building, and publisher transaction reporting.

credential_fields.name: token
credential_fields.label: Awin API token
credential_fields.description: Personal API token from Awin API Credentials.

credential_fields.name: product_feed_key
credential_fields.label: Product feed API key
credential_fields.description: Separate data-feed key from Toolbox > Create-a-Feed. Awin does not accept the Publisher API token for product feeds.

tools.name: accounts_list
tools.description: List the Awin publisher accounts accessible to the authenticated user, including publisher IDs used by other tools.

tools.name: programs_list
tools.description: List Awin advertiser programmes for a publisher, optionally filtered by relationship and country.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code such as GB, DE, FR.

tools.name: program_details_get
tools.description: Get KPIs, description, and commission range for one Awin advertiser programme.

tools.name: offers_list
tools.description: Retrieve Awin promotions and voucher codes from joined and non-joined advertisers.

filters.description: Awin filters object: advertiserIds, exclusiveOnly, membership, regionCodes, status, type, updatedSince.

pagination.description: Awin pagination object: page and pageSize.

tools.name: commission_groups_get
tools.description: Retrieve the active fixed and percentage commission groups for one joined Awin advertiser programme.

effectiveDate.description: Optional ISO-8601 date-time; defaults to the currently active rates.

tools.name: product_feeds_list
tools.description: Download the CSV catalog of Awin product feeds visible to this publisher, including advertiser, feed ID, membership status, last import time, and feed URL. Requires the separate product-feed API key.

tools.name: product_feed_download
tools.description: Download a normalized CSV page for one Awin product feed. Returns product IDs, merchant metadata, prices, descriptions, category, brand, stock state, destination URL, image URL, and commissionable Awin deep link.

language.description: Awin feed language code, normally en.

adultContent.description: Whether adult products may be returned.

tools.name: tracking_link_generate
tools.description: Generate one or a batch of Awin tracking links/deeplinks for an advertiser.

parameters.description: Awin click parameters such as campaign, clickref, clickref2 through clickref6.

tools.name: transactions_list
tools.description: List publisher transactions for a date range and optional advertiser/status filters.

startDate.description: Required by Awin transaction API, ISO date-time.

endDate.description: Required by Awin transaction API, ISO date-time.

tools.name: campaign_performance_report
tools.description: Retrieve publisher performance by day, campaign, and advertiser, including clicks, transactions, sale value, and commission.

region.description: Awin advertiser region code such as GB, DE, FR, or US.

advertiserIds.description: Optional comma-separated advertiser IDs from the selected region.
